info.title: Atc REST API Generator CLI
info.description: CLI tool for scaffolding and validating REST API projects using OpenAPI specifications with Atc.Rest.Api.SourceGenerator.

commands.name: client-typescript
commands.description: Generate TypeScript client files from an OpenAPI specification

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --specification
options.description:
Path to the OpenAPI specification file
(YAML or JSON)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Path to the output directory for the
generated TypeScript files

options.name: --options
options.description:
Path to ApiGeneratorOptions.json file
(optional, auto-discovered if not
specified)

options.name: --no-strict
options.description:
Disable strict validation mode (skip
additional naming convention checks)

options.name: --include-deprecated
options.description:
Include deprecated operations and
schemas in generated code

options.name: --enum-style
options.description:
Enum generation style: Union (string
union types, default) or Enum
(TypeScript enum declarations)

options.name: --hooks
options.description:
Hook generation style: None (default) or
ReactQuery (TanStack Query hooks)

options.name: --hooks-mode
options.description:
React Query hooks variant: Standard
(useQuery, default), Suspense
(useSuspenseQuery), or Both

options.name: --client-type
options.description:
HTTP client library: Fetch (native fetch
API, default) or Axios

options.name: --naming-strategy
options.description: Naming strategy for properties and

options.name: --convert-dates
options.description:
Convert date/date-time properties to
Date objects with automatic JSON
reviver/replacer

options.name: --no-readonly
options.description:
Generate mutable model properties (omit
readonly modifier)

options.name: --zod
options.description:
Generate Zod runtime validation schemas
alongside model and enum files

options.name: --msw
options.description:
Generate Mock Service Worker (MSW)
handlers for frontend testing

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Preview what would be generated without
writing any files

options.name: --watch
options.description:
Watch the specification file for changes
and re-generate automatically

options.name: --report
options.description:
Generate a .generation-report.md file in
the output directory

options.name: --scaffold
options.description:
Generate package.json and tsconfig.json
to make the output a ready-to-use npm
package

options.name: --package-name
options.description:
Package name for generated package.json
(default: derived from OpenAPI
info.title)

options.name: --package-version
options.description:
Package version for generated
package.json (default: 0.1.0)

options.name: --branded-ids
options.description:
Emit branded ID types for `string +
format: uuid` properties whose name ends
in 'Id'. Catches caller mistakes like
getPet(userId) at compile time

options.name: --zod-runtime-validate
options.description:
Validate response payloads at runtime
against the generated Zod schemas. On
mismatch the ApiResult surfaces a
'schemaMismatch' arm with the Zod
issues. Implies --zod

options.name: --enum-runtime-values
options.description:
For Union-style enums, also emit a
runtime '{EnumName}Values' const array
(as const) for iterating/populating
dropdowns without a TS enum or Zod. No
effect with --enum-style Enum

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge multiple OpenAPI specification files into one

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --specification
options.description:
Path to the base OpenAPI
specification file
(auto-discovers part files
by naming convention)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output file path for the
merged specification

options.name: --files
options.description:
Explicit comma-separated
list of files to merge
(overrides auto-discovery)

options.name: --preview
options.description:
Preview merged output
without writing file

options.name: --validate
options.description:
Validate the merged
specification after
merging

options.name: --format
options.description:
yaml                Output format: yaml
(default) or json

options.name: --strategy
options.description:
ErrorOnDuplicate    Merge strategy for
duplicates:
ErrorOnDuplicate
(default),
MergeIfIdentical,
AppendUnique, FirstWins,
LastWins
